module.purpose: Provides centralized focus synchronization and focus-ring behavior for the editor container, including keyboard, mouse, editing, and lifecycle handling.
module.summary: This manager keeps editor instance focus state synchronized with a CSS class on the container, installs document-level keyboard and mouse listeners, and adjusts focus-ring visibility based on editing mode, selection, contextual toolbar focus, and navigation keys. It also applies optional initial focus state and cleans up registered listeners when disposed.
module.businessContext: Supports a graphical editor's accessibility and interaction feedback by keeping focus styling and DOM focus behavior consistent. Failures can leave users with incorrect focus rings, inaccessible editing controls, or stale event listeners.
classes: FocusManager (~L12-81): Coordinates editor focus state, DOM focus, focus rings, and lifecycle listeners
functions: constructor (~L13-37): Initializes focus synchronization, optional autofocus, and DOM event listeners
updateContainerClass (~L46-56): Synchronizes container CSS classes with editor focus state
handleKeyDown (~L58-66): Adjusts focus-ring visibility for editing and navigation keyboard events
handleMouseDown (~L68-71): Restores the container's no-focus-ring class after mouse interaction
focus (~L73-75): Moves DOM focus to the editor container
blur (~L77-80): Completes interactions and optionally removes DOM focus from the container

import { bind } from '@tldraw/utils'
import type { Editor } from '../../Editor'

units.name: FocusManager

detail.name: FocusManager
detail.summary: Manages editor focus state and coordinates focus-related behavior for the editor container.

units.name: constructor

detail.name: constructor
preconditions: editor provides side-effect registration, instance-state access and updates, a container document, and manager resource registration.
postconditions: The manager is initialized with the editor.
If autoFocus differs from the current instance focus state, the instance focus state is updated to the boolean value of autoFocus.
The editor container class is synchronized with the current focus state.
A side-effect listener is registered to synchronize the container class when instance focus changes.
Keydown and mousedown listeners are attached to the editor container document body.
Registered resources can dispose the installed listeners and side-effect subscription.
invariants: The container class is refreshed whenever the observed instance isFocused value changes.
The registered side-effect subscription and DOM listeners are owned by this manager for cleanup.
edgeCases: When autoFocus is omitted or falsy and the current focus state differs, the instance focus state is set to false.
When autoFocus strictly matches the current focus state, no instance-state update is issued.
When the current focus state differs from autoFocus, the update uses boolean coercion rather than preserving an undefined value.
stateMutations: May update editor instance state isFocused.
Registers manager-owned side-effect and DOM listener cleanup callbacks.
detail.summary: Initializes focus management for an editor, synchronizes its instance focus state with the optional autofocus setting, and installs focus-related DOM listeners and side-effect handling.

specLiterals.role: Identifies the editor instance side-effect channel observed for focus-state changes.
DOM event type handled by the manager.
DOM event type handled by the manager.

specTests.then: The editor instance state is updated with isFocused: true, the container class is synchronized, and keydown and mousedown listeners are attached to the container document body.
No instance-state update is issued, while the container class is still synchronized and the focus-related listeners are installed.

units.name: updateContainerClass

detail.name: updateContainerClass
preconditions: The editor provides a container element and instance state through getContainer() and getInstanceState().
postconditions: The container's focused class reflects the current value of instanceState.isFocused.
invariants: The container's focused-state styling is represented by the presence or absence of the dedicated focused class.
edgeCases: When instanceState.isFocused is true, the focused class is applied to the container.
When instanceState.isFocused is false, the focused class is removed from the container.
stateMutations: The container element's class list is mutated to add or remove the focused class.
detail.summary: Synchronizes the editor's focused state with the focus class on its container. The container has the focused class when the editor instance is focused and does not have it otherwise.

specLiterals.role: CSS class that represents the editor's focused state on its container.

specTests.then: The container contains the class tl-container__focused.
The container does not contain the class tl-container__focused.
